The Reality Check
The Broken Bridge in Indian Engineering
A two-sided placement crisis leaving both students and colleges stranded.
STUDENT CRISIS (B2C)
90%+ Graduates Fail Tech Drives
• Rote Theory Over Problem Solving: Colleges teach obsolete syntax. Students freeze when faced with live DSA and system edge cases.
• The AI Text Wall Problem: Generic AI tutors dump dense paragraphs. Tier-2 students suffer cognitive overload and abandon them in <3 minutes.
• Zero Elder Brother Guidance: First-generation engineers have no mentors to pull out a piece of rough paper and dry-run logic step-by-step.
COLLEGE CRISIS (B2B)
Survival Tied to Placement Stats
• Marketing Lifeblood: Admissions in 4,000+ private Indian colleges depend entirely on advertising "90%+ Placement Rates".
• Zero Early Warning: Placement Officers (TPOs) only discover a student is unplaceable in their 7th semester—when it is too late to fix.
• Wasteful Vendor Spend: Institutions spend lakhs on third-party classroom crash courses with near-zero verifiable outcome tracking.

Technical Integrity
Zero-Guesswork: Deterministic Precision
Why SAI is not a generic prompt wrapper: mathematical certainty at every step.
1. Zero AI Code Evaluation
LLMs are strictly forbidden from judging code correctness. Student code executes deterministically inside client-side WebAssembly / Pyodide sandboxes and isolated Judge0 runners against real test suites.

The AI only receives runtime test telemetry to formulate targeted Socratic hints without giving away answers.
2. Ground-Truth Curriculum DAG
Every algorithmic pattern, analogy, and edge case lives in a pre-verified canonical knowledge graph with locked Big-O bounds.

Strict Schema & Fallback: All AI outputs adhere to rigid Pydantic/Zod schemas. Any latency or schema drift immediately trips a circuit breaker to serve curated canonical notes.

Cost Engineering
Cheap for Owner, Premium for User
Built to deliver enterprise-grade margins even on Tier-2 Indian student pricing.
Client-Side Execution (₹0)
80%+ of student code tests run client-side in the browser via Pyodide / WebAssembly, eliminating heavy cloud sandbox server costs.
SVG Canvas vs Video ($0 vs $1000s)
Video diffusion models burn $0.20/min. SAI's Rough.js hand-drawn whiteboard runs locally at 0 GPU overhead and <10ms latency.
Context Caching (70% Token Cut)
Pre-verified DSA curriculum DAGs are cached via Redis and Gemini Implicit Caching, drastically reducing LLM inference burn.
Single-Persona Router
Intelligent router passes messages to exactly ONE brother persona at a time, preventing token multiplication across the squad.
